description.en: Fills the given arrays with a camera's current position and look-at reference point, the counterpart to CMND_SET_CAMERA_POS/CMND_SET_CAMERA_REF.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] position; passed by reference and filled in place.
Array that receives the [x, y, z] look-at reference; passed by reference and filled in place.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Read the current camera position and look-at reference
CMND_GET_CAMERA_POSREF(_hcam, cam_ctrl.now_pos, cam_ctrl.now_ref);
